verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions simulcast or layered (SVC) publishing, or the service switching which layer each subscriber receives. The Network Bandwidth Profile API is described only as letting you prioritize which participant tracks to favor, and the Network Quality API only monitors network quality. Both are adjacent controls, not documented per-subscriber layer adaptation.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
